## Pull request overview

This PR refactors parts of Samigo’s “select assessments” flow (SAK-52310) to reduce overhead when building the student assessment list by tightening collection types, consolidating “updated assessment” lookup, and modernizing a few query/result transformations.

**Changes:**
- Introduces a `PublishedAssessmentService#getUpdatedAssessmentLists(...)` helper and updates `SelectActionListener` to consume sets instead of raw lists.
- Tightens generics for “updated assessment” queries (`List<Set<Long>>`) across service and facade layers.
- Refactors a metadata query result mapping to use Java streams (`Collectors.toMap`).
